hook.name: ModularLaunchpadHook
hook.description: A configurable launchpad hook using universal LP-fee economics: the factory holds the seed LP position and anyone may call harvest() to collect its accrued fees, split 70/30 between creator and protocol. Supports optional anti-snipe buy caps, JIT sandwich defense, creator fee burn, and liquidity-deepening modules; this deployment has no swap-permission flags active.
